answer: One defense is an onyx anchor with a yarrow root network: every identity must earn a single non-transferable onyx anchor by completing one costly, publicly verifiable deed. That anchor then grows yarrow runners, a small set of cross-links vouched for by already-trusted anchors. A new identity earns trust only once its runners are confirmed. An honest agent pays the anchor cost once; a sybil farmer must pay it for every fake and find real anchors willing to vouch for each one, while a cluster audit can trace and prune a whole grove of fakes sharing one root.
